text:
support_engineer_jess: Received a support ticket from a customer app: tool call keeps returning \"400 invalid tool args\" when they pass file metadata.
support_engineer_jess: Customer says payload is JSON but our parser rejects it. They pasted the body; see below.
support_engineer_jess: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/toolcall \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d $'{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\dev\\notes.txt","meta":"desc:\\u0000\\ufeffNew file"}'``` 
support_bot: +auto-ticket #123456 created. Attached raw request payload from the customer.
eng_enzo: quick glance — looks like they wrapped JSON in a shell $'...' string, which will expand escapes. That \\u0000 (null) and \\ufeff (BOM) could be present as raw control chars.
sre_sami: our JSON parser errors on control characters NUL by default. Which client SDK are they using?
support_engineer_jess: they say they call via curl from Windows Git Bash; not using SDK. They pasted exact curl above.
eng_enzo: repro locally: `echo -e '\\u0000' | hexdump` shows 00 in the body — yep. Also \\ufeff will appear as EF BB BF bytes at start of string segments.
eng_enzo: minimal repro I ran:
```bash
printf '%b' "{\"x\":\"hi\\u0000there\"}" | curl -sS -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @- https://staging.api
# server returns 400 json parse error: unexpected control character
```
sre_sami: production parser rejects NULs (control chars) and BOM inside a string. We should improve the error message to say "contains disallowed control character" instead of generic invalid tool args.
prod_ops_tina: customer impact: they hit this when saving notes containing an embedded null from a legacy exporter. They want a migration/quick fix and a better error for others.
eng_enzo: proposed paths:
- ask customer to escape/strip control chars before sending (fast)
- suggest `--data-binary` and ensure no shell interpolation (prevents accidental encoding changes)
- for SDK: add client-side sanitizer that strips BOM and rejects NULs with clear message
- server: detect NUL/BOM and return 422 with details + link to docs
support_engineer_jess: sample fix message I can send to customer:
```text
Hi — it looks like your request body contains hidden control characters (NUL or UTF-8 BOM). Please try sending with `--data-binary @file.json` and remove any BOM or null bytes. If you can't, we can base64 the metadata and decode it server-side.
```
eng_enzo: also note: if customers accidentally send JSON as a *string* (e.g. `-d '"{...}"'`) our tool-call schema will treat the outer as string and then inner JSON won't be parsed into an object -> similar errors. Add a client-side lint to catch JSON-as-string.
sre_sami: I'll open infra ticket to add a more specific parse error and to log offending byte offsets for internal debugging.
prod_ops_tina: tagging for priority P2 for customer workaround; escalate to P1 if they are in paid Dedicated and high-throughput.
support_engineer_jess: thanks. I'll reply with the workaround + ask for a curl --data-binary paste and whether they can try removing the legacy exporter step.
support_engineer_jess: @eng_enzo @sre_sami please ping here when infra ticket exists and when we have an updated error message.
support_bot: Reaction :thumbsup: recorded by support_engineer_jess
